description: Katav helps students use their own Katav study subjects and class context in ChatGPT. Users can list their current study subjects, inspect a selected subject's recent classes, and use that private context to plan review or ask study questions.

defaultPrompt: Help me choose what to review next from my classes.
Summarize the recent classes for one of my subjects.
